description: Announced registry (wholesale) price increases, upcoming and from the past year, plus changes to registrar standard prices seen in TLDMath’s daily checks. Use for "is .com going up?" or "should I renew early?". Optionally filter by TLD.

days.description: How far back to look for registrar price changes. Default 30.

tld.description: Limit to one TLD, e.g. "com". Omit for all.
